summary: Developer reference for seven RoleCall adapters: CCv2/v3 character cards with extensions.rolecall, a v1 lorebook envelope, the flat compendium export, persona and regex JSON exports, a RoleCall-flavored flat preset, and a preset file carrying a Script Sheet. Character detection bids 1.0 only for the RoleCall extension and steps aside for persona exports; lorebook detection recognizes its dedicated wrapper without colliding with SillyTavern world info, and the compendium codec reads and writes RoleCall's flat compendium file (raw entry rows, tree and constraints kept) without the v1 codec claiming it. Character mapping covers identity details, titled greetings, depth injections, presentation, media, and embedded lorebooks. Lorebook mapping flattens RoleCall's nested trigger, matching, injection, timing, grouping, scan-source, and advanced settings into canonical entries. Character export overlays canonical edits onto the sealed source while preserving native fields, including a documented depth-injection write asymmetry. Lorebook export preserves source dates and conditionally writes budget fields. Persona handling keeps brief and content distinct across two supported shapes. Regex handling models the live chat pipeline with open placement values. Preset handling shares the flat SillyTavern grammar but requires RoleCall fingerprint fields and preserves native YAML as sealed data. The source table identifies all seven codecs, shared helpers, schemas, design specs, and constructed samples.

sections.title: Detection
sections.summary: Detection follows registry highest score above 0.5. Character detect returns 1.0 for CCv2 or V3 cards that carry extensions.rolecall whose type is not the literal persona, outranking SillyTavern 0.9 on the same card. Cross-kind firewall: RC persona exports reuse the CCv2 V3 shape with type persona so character returns 0 and toCanonical throws pointing at rolecall-persona instead of tying. Lorebook detect returns 1.0 for a RoleCall v1 export envelope with schemaVersion containing 1.0.0 as a substring and a lorebook object with an entries array; exportDate is optional. No firewall is needed versus ST because ST has a top-level entries object and no lorebook wrapper.

children.title: Character
children.summary: detect returns 1.0 for a CCv2 or V3 card carrying extensions.rolecall and 0 otherwise. Requirements are spec chara_card_v3 or chara_card_v2, a data object, and rolecallExt whose type is not the literal persona. Score 1.0 outranks SillyTavern generic 0.9. Cross-kind firewall: RC persona-export route emits the same CCv2 V3 shape with type persona; character detect returns 0 and toCanonical throws pointing at rolecall-persona so the adapters never tie at 1.0 on the same file.

children.title: Lorebook
children.summary: detect returns 1.0 for a RoleCall v1 export envelope with a schemaVersion string containing 1.0.0 and a lorebook object whose entries is an array, else 0. exportDate is optional for detection and import. The version match is a substring rather than exact equality, so beta tags pass; a nonmatching version scores zero even though the direct structural parser does not hard-reject it. The envelope does not collide with a SillyTavern worldbook, which has a top-level entries object without a lorebook wrapper, so no firewall is needed between the two lorebook codecs.

sections.title: Field map
sections.summary: Field map covers Character RC deltas then Lorebook nesting. Character reuses shared Tavern data mapping and adds extensions.rolecall tagline genre fandom content_rating mapped all_hours late_night after_dark to all-ages mature explicit, source_url creators_note, details full_name title age pronouns, titled alternate greetings, prompt_depth_injections concatenated with depth_prompt origin, presentation casting-card colors fieldOrder background media_links, and assets with expression as emotion; unmapped loadout links ride escrow. Lorebook flattens RoleCallEntryV1 nested groups triggers matching injection priority timing grouping advanced scanSources characterFilter and unsupportedFields ST toggles into flat LorebookEntry; book settings metadata categories map at book level; scanPreset has no v1 wire slot.

children.title: Character
children.summary: Shared Tavern data mapping is documented on sillytavern; this table is RC layer only. extensions.rolecall maps tagline genre fandom content_rating with exact three-way rating, source_url creators_note, details full_name title free-text age pronouns, alternate_greeting_titles merged by index into alternate greetings, prompt_depth_injections as origin rolecall_details concatenated before depth_prompt, and presentation signature gradient palette fieldOrder background spoiler media_links. assets use shared assetsToMedia dialect rolecall with expression as emotion; PNG carrier bytes live in original.rolecall.sourceMedia. character_book is shared bundle re-embed; empty resolution removes stale twin book. id nsfw image urls loadout recommendations trackerPreset linked lists ride whole-card escrow.

children.title: Lorebook
children.summary: Canonical LorebookEntry is flat; RC v1 wire nests each entry into named groups and the codec flattens on import and re-nests on export. Groups cover triggers mode primary secondary selectiveLogic, matching case whole-words scanDepth, injection position depth role, priority sortOrder priority, timing sticky cooldown delay, grouping name category weight, advanced recursion memo ignoreBudget, scanSources four RC toggles, top-level characterFilter probability sideEffects metadata, and unsupportedFields for ST-origin vectorized groupOverride useGroupScoring automationId matchCharacterDepthPrompt matchCreatorNotes as first-class canonical. Book settings metadata categories map at book level; scanPreset has no RC v1 wire slot.

sections.title: Escrow and round-trip
sections.summary: Character twin stores whole parsed card in original.rolecall.raw plus PNG sourceMedia when input was PNG. Export clones raw or fresh V3, applies Tavern overlay, media dialect rolecall, then applyBodyToRcExt three-state for presentation fields gradientColors palette background fieldOrder distinguishing untouched edited cleared while rebuilding nested details; scalars write when defined and cleared values on twin stay rather than delete. Depth-injection asymmetry: import concatenates rolecall_details and depth_prompt origins but export only rewrites depth_prompt via shared applyBodyToData; applyBodyToRcExt never writes prompt_depth_injections so details array re-emits from twin. Lorebook twin original rolecall-lorebook raw overlays by id; budgetMode entryBudget write only when twin had them or from-scratch differs from defaults; exportDate preserved from twin and only regenerated from-scratch, which differs from source product always minting fresh exportDate in the design spec.

sections.title: Quirks
sections.summary: Quirks pin RC edges and summarize preset, Script Sheet, persona and regex codecs. rolecall-script-sheet reads a preset file carrying script_sheet, or the older promptbook key, as a Script Sheet, outranking rolecall-preset, and writes the sheet back with script_sheet beside its blocks. rolecall-preset shares SillyTavern's flat grammar but requires native fingerprint keys; a from-scratch export writes a neutral empty choice_groups array so it stays distinguishable and self-readable. V3 source as object array is unread by shared Tavern string[] decoder so object form rides twin; greeting titles omit key when all untitled; background keeps customUrl or backgroundId slot; real sprites use type expression mapped to emotion. Persona codec claims 1.0 on rcpersona envelope and chara_card_v2 lookalike with type persona; brief never swaps with content; sections compile or fold unfold description; after_dark omitted when not mature explicit; no rcpersona PNG keyword path in code despite design specs. Regex codec models live find_pattern pipeline only at 0.9 for single script with rules; placements map to phases open-union; no substituteFind on this wire; unknown keys ride extras. coverage.ts is editor lens only not round-trip.

sections.title: Source of truth
sections.summary: Source of truth maps character to index.ts and lorebook, persona, regex, and preset codecs to sibling files. Shared Tavern mapping, lore enums, assets, PNG and card readers, coverage, canonical escrow, persona schema, design specs, and constructed samples are also listed.
